concept: a bog hound that drags its prey under
a huge glacier-hearted ogre brute that crushes shield walls
a basilisk whose gaze locks the limbs
a chain devil that hooks and hauls
a giant toad that swallows whole
a behir that gores and tramples a line
a shrieking fungus that deafens the cavern
a stirge swarm that clings and drains
a gorgon that stamps the ground and petrifies
a dire boar that charges and bowls riders over
a roper that snares with sticky strands
a harpy whose song charms sailors overboard
